build_criterion_r3f: build a Fairseq sentence prediction criterion with R3F noisy KL regularization for robust representations
create_noise_sampler: create a normal or uniform noise sampler with configurable epsilon for embedding perturbation
compute_symm_kl: compute the symmetric KL divergence between noised logits and original input logits
run_forward_loss: run the forward pass to compute combined NLL loss and noisy KL regularization loss
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training to compute average loss and accuracy
